label: GO, last ~7 trials of the episode, confidently choosing a2 after a common rewarded trial
explanation: Fires only at GO steps, and almost only in episode trials 90-99 (99.9% of mass; value-head output is in its lowest bin there). Within those, it needs a strongly a2-favouring policy (choice logit < -4.4, model_act == a2; it essentially never fires on a1 choices) and a rewarded previous trial (98% of mass) reached by a common transition (rare previous trial: 0.1x lift). Magnitude builds up over consecutive rewarded common a2 trials late in the episode, from about 0.1-0.3 at the first such trial to near max after 3-4 in a row, and it falls off sharply after an unrewarded or rare trial. Mostly seen when S2 is the good state. Never fires at D1 or D2, before trial ~85, or when choosing a1. Uses only observed variables: the model own GO policy logit plus the observed previous outcome. Dev scores: P 0.72, R 0.87, F1 0.79, mass recall 0.94. Missed activations are low-magnitude ones (the first trial of a run, or trials just before 93). It is partial because about 28% of predicted steps are silent, mostly at the start of a rewarded a2 run where activation has not built up yet.

scorecard.summary: Graded preference over last trial (GO: a2 S2 r, a2 S2 u, a1 S2 r) and value (model) (GO: decile 0 (9 ); timing cues that raise it most: phase=GO & ep_dec=9, phase=D1 & ep_dec=0, phase=D2 & ep_dec=0.
